create_text_inpainting_pipeline: create a text inpainting pipeline using CLIPSeg for mask generation and Stable Diffusion for image inpainting
run_text_inpainting: run text-based inpainting on an image by generating a mask from text and repainting masked regions with a prompt
build_segmentation_mask: build an image segmentation mask from text input using CLIPSeg model and processor
configure_diffusion_scheduler: configure a diffusion scheduler with steps_offset and skip_prk_steps for Stable Diffusion inpainting
review_text_inpainting_class: review the TextInpainting class that inherits from DiffusionPipeline and StableDiffusionMixin for text-guided image inpainting
